title: Representation Measurements Under Function-Preserving Reparameterizations
abstract: arXiv:2608.27020v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Hidden coordinates are not uniquely determined by a language model's input--output function, so representation-derived measurements should be invariant to function-preserving changes of basis. This study shows that column-permutation parallel analysis violates function-preserving reparameterization invariance because its reference distribution and selected component count can change while the model function and observed covariance spectrum remain fixed. More generally, a data-internal reference procedure cannot simultaneously preserve every coordinate marginal, remain orthogonally equivariant, and remove cross-coordinate covariance. Empirically, across five models, three retrieval domains, and 75 transformations, median component-count disagreement is 0.79 and median fixed-threshold decision disagreement is 0.26. translated_title: 在保函数重参数化下的表示测量
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.27020v1 公告类型：交叉 公告摘要：隐藏坐标并非由语言模型的输入-输出函数唯一确定，因此源自表示的测量应对保函数的基变换保持不变。本研究显示，列置换平行分析违反了保函数重参数化不变性，因为其参考分布和所选成分数量可能发生变化，而模型函数和观测协方差谱保持不变。更一般地，数据内部参考程序无法同时保持每个坐标边际、保持正交等变性，并移除跨坐标协方差。实证上，在五个模型、三个检索领域和75个变换中，中位成分数量不一致性为0.79，中位固定阈值决策不一致性为0.26。仅中心化对照隔离了参考驱动效应，在1,200个成分数量中，有1,141个发生变化，尽管模型函数未变。
tldr: 本研究揭示了列置换平行分析在保函数重参数化下缺乏不变性，并证明数据内部参考程序无法同时满足所有关键性质，实证表明表示测量在模型函数不变时仍可能大幅波动。
en_tdlr: This study reveals that column-permutation parallel analysis lacks invariance under function-preserving reparameterizations, and demonstrates that data-internal reference procedures cannot simultaneously satisfy all key properties, with empirical evidence showing representation measurements can vary substantially even when the model function is unchanged.
